about: Curated regular deals. Each entry names the page that states it (`evidence[].url`) and the words Slomp must find there (`find`, all of them, close together) before it shows the deal. `absorbs` lists words that mark a roundup entry as the same offer. An entry with `suppress` only stops a roundup entry known not to apply in Texas. Checked on 2026-10-05; `slomp regulars` shows each entry's current status.
